#!/bin/bash
set -eou pipefail

VERIFY_TIMEOUT=${1:-${VERIFY_TIMEOUT:-3}}

if ! /usr/bin/pgrep -f ".*register-the-runner"  > /dev/null && ! /usr/bin/pgrep -f "gitlab.*runner"  > /dev/null ; then
  exit 1
fi

status=0
verify_output=$(timeout "${VERIFY_TIMEOUT}" gitlab-runner verify --url= 2>&1) || status=$?

if (( status == 143 )) || (( status == 124 )) ; then
  echo "'gitlab-runner verify' terminated by timeout, not a conclusive failure" >&2
  exit 0
fi

if grep -qiE "connection refused|no such host|name resolution|temporary failure|i/o timeout|dial tcp|no route to host|server misbehaving|could not resolve host|network is unreachable" <<<"${verify_output}" ; then
  echo "'gitlab-runner verify' could not reach the GitLab server; treating as inconclusive, not a runner failure" >&2
  exit 0
fi

if (( status > 0 )) ; then
  exit ${status}
fi

grep -qE "is (alive|valid)" <<<"${verify_output}"

data.register-the-runner:
#!/bin/sh
signal_handler() {
  if [ ! -d "/proc/$register_pid" ]; then
    wait $register_pid
  fi
  exit
}
trap 'signal_handler' QUIT INT

MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS=30

RUN_UNTAGGED=""
ACCESS_LEVEL=""

if [ -n "$CI_SERVER_TOKEN" ] && [ "${CI_SERVER_TOKEN#glrt-}" != "$CI_SERVER_TOKEN" ]; then
  RUN_UNTAGGED=""
  ACCESS_LEVEL=""
  unset REGISTER_LOCKED
  unset RUNNER_TAG_LIST
fi

for i in $(seq 1 "${MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS}"); do
  echo "Registration attempt ${i} of ${MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS}"
  /entrypoint register \
    ${RUN_UNTAGGED} \
    ${ACCESS_LEVEL} \
    --template-config /configmaps/config.template.toml \
    --clone-url "http://gitlab2-webservice-default.gitlabv2.svc.cluster.local:8181/" \
    --non-interactive &

  register_pid=$!
  wait $register_pid
  retval=$?

  if [ ${retval} = 0 ]; then
    break
  elif [ ${i} = ${MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS} ]; then
    exit 1
  fi

  sleep 5
done
